seo.metaTitle: ATS-optimized resume & CV builder — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Build a clean, single-column ATS-compatible resume from `templates/resume-ats.json` that parses cleanly in Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever without storing your career history on resume websites. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /templates/resume-ats.json with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: ATS-optimized resume & CV builder processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /templates/resume-ats.json (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does ATS-optimized resume & CV builder upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. ATS-optimized resume & CV builder executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /templates/resume-ats.json. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate ATS-optimized resume & CV builder?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/resume_builder.json or open /tools/resume-builder?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
